argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$dir='E:\PC-Control\TunnelChrome-20261009'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dir){throw 'destination_already_exists'}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null
$base='https://github.com/openai/tunnel-client/releases/download/v0.0.16/'
$asset='tunnel-client-runtime-v0.0.16-windows-amd64.zip'
$zip=Join-Path $dir $asset
$checks=Join-Path $dir 'SHA256SUMS.txt'
[Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base+'SHA256SUMS.txt') -OutFile $checks -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20
$line=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $checks|Where-Object {$_ -like ('*'+$asset)})|Select-Object -First 1
if(!$line){throw 'asset_sha_not_found'}
$expected=($line.Trim() -split '\s+')[0].ToLowerInvariant()
if($expected -notmatch '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'){throw 'invalid_expected_sha'}
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base+$asset) -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 45
$actual=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if($actual -ne $expected){throw 'download_sha256_mismatch'}
$expanded=Join-Path $dir 'app'
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $expanded
$binary=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $expanded -Recurse -File -Filter 'tunnel-client.exe'|Select-Object -First 1)
if($binary.Count -ne 1){throw 'executable_not_found'}
$version=& $binary[0].FullName --version
[ordered]@{installed=$true;verified=$true;path=$binary[0].FullName;version=($version -join '');archiveSize=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $zip).Length}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
